_comment: Animation catalog — the curated list of visual + audio bundles that designers can attach to spells, abilities, items, and effects. Each record indexes one visual (matching a key in the VFX projectile registry at web/src/vfx/effectRegistry.ts) and zero-to-two SFX names (matching generators in web/src/battle/audio/Sfx.ts). Adding new visuals or sounds requires a code change; this file just lets designers pick from what's available. The 'none' record is a sentinel meaning 'no visual, no sound' — use it explicitly to suppress fallback behavior. See docs/data_dictionary/animation.md.

animations.name: None
animations.description: Explicit no-op — suppress any default visual and silence both SFX slots. Use when a record should be deliberately silent.

animations.name: Lightning Strike
animations.description: Jagged blue-white zigzag drawn from caster to target, fading out over ~280ms. Cast roar + crackling impact.

animations.name: Magic Dart
animations.description: Fast arcane orb with a sparkle trail and a bright impact ring. The classic single-target arcane projectile.

animations.name: Magic Arrow
animations.description: Glowing shaft with a bright tip, sparkle trail, and a fragmenting impact. Reads as 'magic, not mundane' on aimed shots.

animations.name: Fireball Burst
animations.description: Bowed orange projectile to the target, with an explosion sound on impact. Pair with an AOE on the destination.

animations.name: Generic Projectile
animations.description: Slow-bowed arcane line. The default for any projectile spell that doesn't specify another animation.

animations.name: Healing Sparkles
animations.description: Rising green sparkles below the target. Use for any positive-restoration spell.

animations.name: Shield Aura
animations.description: Soft expanding gold ring around the target with a crystalline chime. Use for AC buffs / protective effects.

animations.name: Status Aura
animations.description: General gold ring + cast chime — covers neutral status applies like sleep, charm, push, light.

animations.name: Curse Aura
animations.description: Soft expanding purple ring with a chime. Use for hex / curse / debuff spells.

animations.name: Turn Undead
animations.description: Bright radial burst with a holy chord cast sound. Reserved for radiant / undead-bane abilities.

animations.name: Teleport Blink
animations.description: Soft arcane burst at the destination with a chime — pairs with the actor sprite snapping to the new tile.

animations.name: Summon Burst
animations.description: Radial burst at the spawn tile + chime. Use for animate_dead / summon spells.

animations.name: Utility Clack
animations.description: Lock-pick / mechanical SFX with no visual. Use for non-visual utility spells (knock, dispel-lock).

animations.name: Level Up Chime
animations.description: Triumphant arpeggio with a sparkle tail. Best for character-progression moments (level up, learn ability).
